label: R18-QUARTUS-PHYSICAL
title: Run a fresh A10 physical probe for the R18 timing batch
dependency_gate: T-019 source 50b046b69341c13c4b93fffd89e5dda7d81590ff passed focused, joint L0/L1, expected-fail and L2 A-F with 3400 strict commits before any remote physical action.
scope: Create a new isolated source/project manifest from the exact R18 physical source, regenerate the Quartus-21.4 compatibility copy, then run guarded synthesis, fitter, signoff STA and custom directional/top-N queries serially. Report measured timing only.
writes: the single fresh remote probe directory declared above
forbidden_regions: T-014 or any existing Quartus database
quartus_pgm, JTAG/Flash writes, programming, power-on or board test
directional_acceptance: idex_valid to fp_exec.state.TX_DONE old cone count/slack/levels
pp_pre to pack_scan, pack_scan to pack_pre, pack_pre to pack_mid and pack_mid to slot_result
exmem_valid, memwb_wb_rd and exmem_wb_rd to acc and acc_flags
global sys_clk_50 top-50 and replacement cluster classification

resource.local: preparation/read-only monitoring only while remote Quartus runs
resource.remote: one Quartus process; MaxRunSeconds=43200 per stage; MinFreeMb=16384 admission target; no overlap with another EDA process
resource.safety: fresh read-only resource/EDA/forbidden-artifact preflight; any guard breach or nonzero stage exit stops before the next stage

acceptance: Fresh manifest and canonical QSF closure pass; synthesis, fitter and signoff/custom STA complete under guards. A negative setup result is accepted only as an honest timing observation and starts another RTL batch; it never releases assembler or board actions.
board_policy: No Quartus assembler, SOF/JIC/RBF/POF/JBC/SVF/JAM, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
